overview.mechanism: Combines insulin secretion stimulated by gliclazide with metformin-mediated glucose regulation.
uses: Glycemic control in type 2 diabetes; verify immediate- versus modified-release formulation and the approved combination strength.

paragraphs.text: A randomized study investigated gliclazide with metformin in treatment-naive patients with marked hyperglycemia. It was not a renal-failure trial and does not establish suitability of a fixed-dose combination in dialysis.

Metformin is contraindicated below eGFR 30 mL/min/1.73 m² in its US label. The accompanying sulfonylurea does not override that restriction; component information is not a complete dosing instruction for the fixed-dose product.

sources.citation: Comparative efficacy and safety of sitagliptin or gliclazide combined with metformin in treatment-naive patients with type 2 diabetes: a randomized noninferiority study. PubMed PMID: 39792745.

revision_log.change: Source-linked descriptive overview and clinical evidence; no new unsupported dose recommendation or inferred dialysis schedule.
